name: MPDD: Metal Parts Defect Detection Dataset
description: Industrial defect detection benchmark comprising 1,346 high-resolution images across six painted and untreated metal manufacturing part categories (Bracket Black, Bracket Brown, Bracket White, Connector, Metal Plate, and Tubes). Captured under challenging industrial conditions with variable object positioning, multiple distances, and non-uniform backgrounds, providing pixel-precise defect annotation masks.
